texts.li: [watched,!thief] {X_nameDef} keeps coming. The wild {X_kind} the colony has been watching for days comes down to the edge of the fields at dusk and sits looking at the lights, and {A_nameDef}, who named it, swears it's looking for {A_objective}.\n\nThe council could leave it something to eat, keep the stores shut and a watch on them, try to catch it, let it be, or drive it off.

[thief] {X_nameDef} has been at the stores again. The wild {X_kind} the colony named gets in at night and makes off with what it can carry, and leaves the sacks torn. {A_nameDef} still won't hear a word against it.\n\nThe council could feed it and see whether it stops, set a watch on the stores, try to catch it, let it be, or drive it off.

[fed,asked2|asked3] {X_nameDef} comes for what the colony leaves out now, and waits at the edge of the fields for it at the same hour every evening. {A_nameDef} has started to think it's half tame already.\n\nThe council can go on feeding it, try for it with a ball, let it be, or drive it off.

[shiny] {X_nameDef} is still here, and still shining in the wrong colors in the evening light. Every trainer on the road would give a season's pay to be where the colony is. {A_nameDef} named it, and goes out to look at it every evening.\n\nThe council could leave it food, try to catch it, let it be, or drive it off.

[rumoured] So the rumour was true. {X_nameDef}, the shiny {X_kind} the trainer at the gate spoke of, is on the colony's land, and has been for days; {A_nameDef} named it and the name has stuck.\n\nThe council could leave it food, try to catch it, let it be, or drive it off.

[feared,asked2|asked3] {X_nameDef} is still out there, and the colony has kept the stores shut and the children in because of it. Nobody has been hurt, and nothing more has been taken.\n\nThe council can keep the watch up, try to catch it, let it be, or drive it off.

[asked2|asked3] {X_nameDef} is still on the colony's land. Everyone has a story about it by now, and {A_nameDef} has a name for the place it sleeps.\n\nWhat the colony does about it is the council's to say.

li.label: Leave food out for it
li.outcome: {A_nameDef} carried food out to the edge of the fields for {X_nameDef} and left it there. By morning it was gone, and nothing else was.

li.label: Keep the stores shut, and a watch on them
li.outcome: The stores are shut tight at dusk, and {B_nameDef} sits the night at the gate with a lamp. {X_nameDef} came, looked, and went away hungry.

li.label: Let {A_nameDef} try to catch it
li.outcome: {A_nameDef} has gone out to the edge of the fields with a ball at the belt and a great deal of patience. The throw is {A_possessive} to make.

li.label: Let it be
li.outcome: The council let {X_nameDef} be. It is part of the land, for now, and the colony will go on pointing it out at dusk.

li.label: Drive it off
li.outcome: {A_nameDef} and another went out at dusk with torches and a great deal of noise, and {X_nameDef} went before them over the edge of the land.
